Fretboard Daily: Triads, Sus Chords & 7th Arpeggios

The 4-week program: C → G → D → A. Tick Done when you finish a day (it goes into your practice history), and use the small box at the start of each row to mark the shapes you've practiced. New here? Start with the Guide.

Week 1: Key of C

Chords this week: I = C, ii = Dm, IV = F, V = G, vi = Am
Scale: C – D – E – F – G – A – B

Chords in the key

# Chord Root – 3rd – 5th Key degrees 7th chord (adds) sus2 (R-2-5) sus4 (R-4-5)

  • Then find the hidden triad (last column): leave out the root and you're playing that chord.

Week 1 · Day 7: Put it together

  • Play each progression 4 times with a metronome, one chord per bar. These shapes are picked so your fingers move as little as possible.
  • Scale fill: hold the C shape from Day 1, then play the grey scale notes between its chord tones on just those 3 strings (see the scale map at the top of this week). Do the same with G and Am.
  • Quiz: without looking, name the notes in C, F, G and Am, and say where the 3rd is in each shape.
